newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toshiba aims for PC sales of 1 trln yen in 97/98.
newsitem.headline: Toshiba aims for PC sales of 1 trln yen in 97/98.

text.p: Toshiba Corp said on Thursday that it would aim to boost its personal computer sales to one trillion yen in the year from April 1, 1997, from an estimated 730 billion yen in 1996/97.
The target of one trillion yen worth of sales includes notebook and desktop PCs in both the domestic and overseas markets, a Toshiba spokesman said.
The estimated 1996/97 sales would be up 82 percent from the previous year, he said.
"The market is growing so we would also like to boost our sales," the spokesman said.
The company will also aim to become the world's third largest PC maker by the year 2000/01, the spokesman said. Currently it is the fifth largest PC maker in the global market, he said.
